passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should carefully consider the risk factors set forth below as well as the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K in connection with evaluating the Company. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. Certain statements in “Risk Factors” are forward-looking statements. See “Item 7 — Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations — Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements .” Summary of Risk Factors The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results. Risks Related to Our Business • Our business is particularly sensitive to reductions in discretionary consumer and corporate spending as a result of downturns in the economy. • Natural or man-made disasters, an outbreak of highly infectious or contagious disease, political instability, civil unrest, terrorist activity or war could materially adversely affect the number of visitors to our facilities and disrupt our operations. • Our business is sensitive to the willingness of our customers to travel. • We are subject to extensive regulations that govern our operations in any jurisdiction where we operate. • Certain local gaming laws apply to our gaming activities and associations in jurisdictions where we operate or plan to operate. • We depend primarily on our properties in two markets for all of our cash flow, and because we are a parent company, our primary source of cash is and will be distributions from our subsidiaries. • Our debt instruments, current debt service obligations and substantial indebtedness may restrict our current and future operations. • We are subject to fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates. • We extend credit to a portion of our patrons, and we may not be able to collect gaming receivables from our credit patrons. • Win rates for our gaming operations depend on a variety of factors, some beyond our control, and the winnings of our gaming patrons could exceed our casino winnings. 18 Table of Conte n ts • We face the risk of fraud and cheating. • Our operations face significant competition, which may increase in the future. • Our attempts to expand our business into new markets and new ventures, including through acquisitions or strategic transactions, may not be successful. • Our loan receivable is subject to certain risks, which could materially adversely affect our financial position, results of operations and cash flows. • There are significant risks associated with our current and planned credit_strengths.text: Revenue and operating income have grown steadily across the three-year trend, with the latest year showing the strongest top-line and operating profit. This scale supports a diversified integrated-resort platform, and the operating margin sits well above the sector median, indicating pricing power and cost discipline relative to hotels and motels peers.

Operating cash flow remains substantial and covers capital expenditure, leaving positive free cash flow. Cash on hand plus internally generated funds provide a buffer against the upcoming maturity wall, and the current ratio exceeds the sector median, suggesting adequate near-term liquidity for a capital-intensive gaming operator.

key_risks.text: The issuer depends primarily on properties in two markets for all cash flow, and as a parent company its primary source of cash is distributions from subsidiaries. This concentration means any regulatory, travel or demand shock in Macao or Singapore could impair upstreaming and debt service at the holding company level.

Debt maturities are front-loaded, with a large portion due within the next twelve months and further sizable repayments in years two and three. Refinancing this wall amid a significant leverage profile and rising rates could pressure interest coverage, which already trails the sector median.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is positive but below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is modest relative to peers. The indicative financial risk profile is significant, with leverage above the sector median and cash-flow tier at the weaker end, leaving limited headroom before a downgrade threshold.

Shareholder distributions absorb most free cash flow, with buybacks and dividends together exceeding internally generated funds after capex. This limits deleveraging capacity and means debt reduction depends on EBITDA growth or asset sales rather than retained cash flow, a key constraint on the credit profile.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer is a large, cash-generative gaming operator with revenue and operating income trending upward, but leverage sits above the sector median and the indicative financial risk profile is significant. Cash flow coverage of debt is weaker than peers, and the maturity wall requires active refinancing.

Our forward view is that credit quality will hinge on Macao and Singapore demand durability, refinancing execution and moderating shareholder returns. Absent EBITDA growth or debt reduction, leverage headroom is thin, and the concentrated cash-flow source remains a structural vulnerability. We would monitor these factors closely.

credit_strengths.text: 收入及經營溢利於三年趨勢中穩步增長，最近一年錄得最強勁的頂線收入及經營溢利。此規模支持多元化的綜合度假村平台，而經營利潤率遠高於行業中位數，顯示相對於酒店及汽車旅館同業的定價能力及成本紀律。
經營現金流仍然龐大並足以覆蓋資本開支，留下正數自由現金流。手頭現金加上內部產生資金為即將到期的債務牆提供緩衝，而流動比率高於行業中位數，顯示此資本密集型博彩營運商具備充足的短期流動性。

key_risks.text: 發行人所有現金流主要依賴兩個市場的物業，而作為母公司，其主要現金來源為附屬公司的分派。此集中度意味著澳門或新加坡的任何監管、旅遊或需求衝擊，均可能損害向上游現金流及控股公司層面的債務償付。
債務到期前置，其中一大部分於未來十二個月內到期，第二及第三年亦有進一步可觀還款。在槓桿顯著及利率上升的環境下為此債務牆再融資，可能對利息覆蓋率構成壓力，而該比率已落後於行業中位數。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率為正數但低於行業中位數，而自由現金流對債務比率相對同業適度。指示性財務風險狀況為顯著，槓桿高於行業中位數，現金流級別處於較弱一端，在觸及降級門檻前剩餘空間有限。
股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，回購及股息合計超過扣除資本開支後的內部產生資金。此限制去槓桿能力，意味著債務削減取決於EBITDA增長或資產出售而非保留現金流，為信用狀況的關鍵制約。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人為大型、現金生成能力強的博彩營運商，收入及經營溢利呈上升趨勢，但槓桿高於行業中位數，指示性財務風險狀況為顯著。現金流對債務覆蓋弱於同業，而到期債務牆需要積極再融資。
我們的前瞻觀點是信用質素將取決於澳門及新加坡需求的可持續性、再融資執行及股東回報的緩和。若缺乏EBITDA增長或債務削減，槓桿空間薄弱，而集中的現金流來源仍為結構性弱點。我們將密切監察此等因素。
